# WotR Bot Protocol fixtures

`vocabulary-0.1.json` is the base game's vocabulary of the WotR Bot Protocol
(https://github.com/behindmedia/wotr-protocol, commit `ce695c1f3feafa2583e8aa672937199ce522cc57`), copied unchanged
under its MIT licence (`LICENSE`, Copyright (c) 2026 Behind Media). The protocol seat's tests (BOT-225) check that the
server's own vocabulary writes exactly these keys.
